NOT WIRED, and this is the one honest gap in the pin. It reaches nflverse live for the pre-2018 blend-weight tuning window. It operates on the POLARS frame directly (filter/select before to_pandas), so routing it through the pandas pin is a real refactor rather than a call-site swap. It does not feed data/gold/ -- the blend weights it tunes are already frozen in the deployed blend artifact -- so no gold column and no gate baseline depends on it. Named here rather than left for a reader to discover.
